# Third-party test inputs

`in/adobe-*.json` are sample crJSON documents from
[adobe/profile-evaluator](https://github.com/adobe/profile-evaluator)
(`testfiles/asset-rubrics/`, commit `1d947fb`), Copyright Adobe, licensed
under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The `v-*` inputs are modified copies of
`adobe-capture-then-ai-edits.json`, each changed as described in
`scripts/rubric-conformance-golden.py`.
